verdict.rationale: AutoGen provides robust built-in multi-agent orchestration: RoundRobinGroupChat and selector-based teams for shared-context turn-taking, graph-based workflows (GraphFlow) for directed multi-agent orchestration, UserProxyAgent for human-in-the-loop handoffs, and AgentTool for nesting agents as tools within other agents. This directly supports handoffs, subagents, and crew-like team workflows within a single orchestration framework. missing for 10: independent hands-on benchmarks specifically validating complex handoff/subagent scenarios (community evidence is mostly about older 0.2 version and general sentiment, not concrete validation of newer GraphFlow/AgentTool orchestration).
